alerts.title: Oil Breaks $100—and This Rally Has Legs
alerts.why: Escalation at the Strait of Hormuz threatens global supply, triggering a risk-off flight to gold and a supply-side premium for crude oil.

alerts.title: Iran war live: Iran media say ‘enemy’ projectiles hit Sirik areas
alerts.why: Geopolitical escalation in the Persian Gulf increases risk premiums, driving safe-haven demand for gold and supply disruption fears for crude oil.
